purpose: Independent local LightGBM V4 candidate; preserve V2 and V3; no GitHub push
data_basis: Same archived V2 GFS forecasts and quality-checked station observations as V3
design_basis: Same three variants, feature schema, row signatures, loss targets, validation cases and output windows as V3; no CatBoost weights or predictions are used as features
forecast_source: Same GFS seamless run initialized 2026-11-02T06:00:00+00:00 as V2/V3

variants.lightgbm_base_full: V2 annual fixed-day training pairs with matching exact weekly runs preferred; GFS temperature/humidity/rain, local-hour sine/cosine, forecast-day band
variants.lightgbm_base_exact: Same six predictors, exact weekly runs only; row-matched control for station-history features
variants.lightgbm_history_exact: Same rows as base_exact; add station history, age, complete rain sums, coverage and recent forecast errors available at the exact issue time

feature_issue_policy: Identical to V3. All consumed observations and assumed arrival times are at/before issuance; prior forecast issues precede issuance. One initial history context is used for the entire 168-hour frozen forecast.
station_history_policy: V3's six-hour expiry, explicit ages/coverage and no missing-rain zero fill. Arrivals assumed as measurement plus one hour. At the frozen issue X50/X66 readings are about nine hours old; expired histories stay missing.
temperature_humidity: Native LightGBM regression_l1 on observed minus GFS; humidity clipped to 0–100
rain: Native LightGBM binary classifier plus positive-amount L2 regressor; expected amount is probability times conditional amount, minimum 0.28 mm when wet. No class weighting or post-hoc calibration is fitted.
tuning: One predeclared conservative LightGBM configuration. No hyperparameter search or early stopping. Algorithm-specific constraints differ from CatBoost; V3/V4 data and features are matched exactly.
selection: Per station/component, over all seven forecast days: October MAE for temperature/humidity, RMSE for rain amount, Brier score for probability. Choose among raw GFS, V2, LightGBM variants and training climatology. V3 is a comparator only and cannot become a V4 component. Ties prefer V2.
baseline_comparison: V2 October recipes refitted pre-October; V3 uses saved pre-October-fit validation predictions on identical target/issue cases. Final fitted parameters are never scored against October labels. October is reused selection evidence, not an untouched final test.
forecast_lead_limit: Annual rows are day-band proxies; exact issue times are available only for weekly runs. No arbitrary hourly issue or remote-location skill is established.
joint_window_probability: Unavailable for 6/12/24 hours; never add marginal hourly probabilities
new_actuals: November observations stay withheld. Future scoring verifies locks and does not fit or change models.
station_policy: X51/X67 retain raw fallback without October support. X66 retains user-selected t/h with its sensor discrepancy flagged.
